paragraphs: InnoSoft Canada Inc. sells recreation management software under the Fusion name, aimed at recreation departments of all sizes. The product line is listed as Fusion, Fusion Wave, FusionGO, Fusion Play and Fusion Club. Services listed beside those products are Cloud Hosting, Hardware, Integrated Payments and Training. The flagship product is described as the foundation of a recreation department. Rec management is described as the singular focus behind the software.

The home page reports 320+ Schools, Colleges, & Municipalities, along with 500K Daily Check-Ins and 5M Active Users. Quotes on the page are attributed to Worcester Polytechnic Institute and Wake Forest University. A video item on the same page is titled Breaking Ground with The University of Pittsburgh Campus Recreation. The contact block gives InnoSoft Canada Inc. an address in Markham, ON, Canada.

quote.text: Our software and services empower recreation departments of all sizes to get the most out of their facilities.
